messages:
devx-maria: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a slim refresh of the starter kit quickstart focusing on auth + first deploy. Main goals: simpler ephemeral key example, update SDK snippets for v5, and fix a few broken links.

amy: thanks! can you drop the PR link when it's ready? happy to review the snippets.

devx-maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starterkit/pull/314 — it's a docs-only change. files: docs/auth.md, examples/ephemeral.md, quickstart.md

ben: glanced at the ephemeral example, one question: are we recommending server-side token exchange or direct ephemeral via SDK helper? we should pick one.

chris: +1 on server-side exchange. avoid exposing long-lived keys in examples.

devx-maria: agreed. current example uses a tiny server exchange. snippet:
```
// server: exchange ephemeral token
const resp = await fetch('/api/ephemeral', { method: 'POST' });
const { ephemeral_key } = await resp.json();
// client: use ephemeral_key
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: ephemeral_key });
```

amy: tiny wording nit in quickstart.md line ~48: 'instantiate' -> 'initialize'

devx-maria: good catch, fixing.

doc-bot: PR 314 — linters: 1 warning (docs/style) — see https://ci.redwood-inference.dev/checks/314

sam: can runtime team confirm recommended ephemeral TTL? current snippet uses 5m. @ben @chris

ben: runtime prefers 10m for interactive quickstarts, but 5m is fine for demos. file a note in auth.md.

devx-maria: updated auth.md to recommend 10m for production demos, kept 5m in example for clarity. also added migration note: SDK v4 -> v5: rename `Redwood` -> `RedwoodClient` and `apiKey` -> `apiKey` (no behavior change) — want someone from SDK team to sanity-check.

amy: I can check the SDK phrasing tomorrow.

doc-bot: preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.dev/starterkit/314

deploy-bot: netlify-preview ready — https://deploy-preview-314--starterkit.netlify.app/quickstart

chris: small ask — add a one-line "what changed" at top of quickstart so existing users know this is auth-focused refresh.

devx-maria: done, added a short changelog paragraph.

sam: LGTM from security side. please ensure example server endpoint uses env var for long-lived key: `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` in the server note.

devx-maria: yep included a code comment about that.

amy: reviewed and left one inline suggestion on the PR re: wording. nothing blocking.

ben: reviewing the migration note now.

devx-maria: thanks all — target to merge tomorrow EOD unless other blockers. :rocket:

amy: :thumbsup:

chris: :shipit:

ben: will finish my review today.
